items.recommend_why: Free to try and undo; the only way to measure it. Check ATLAS's next ~8 fills: if they are not clearly better than 10-16 ticks, switch it off.

items.question: Order flow on the practice account (Sim, no real money): yes = text /oflane on in Telegram
items.why: The order-flow bot fades a sweep of yesterday's / overnight / opening-range high or low only when the sweep bar was absorbed. On 43 real trading days (Sep 28 - Nov 25, Monday prior-day fix in), the first trade of each day: 39 trades, 4.5 a week, 51% won, +0.51R a trade, PF 2.40, +$2,931 at 1 micro (about $1,450 a month), worst drawdown $542. Honest catch: the older half was much better than the newer half (+0.91R vs +0.10R a trade), later trades in the same day lose (-$561 to -$834 at 1 micro), it is one 2-month market, and 0 forward days have been scored. 8 more order-flow idea families were tested overnight: no new edge.
items.impact: $0: practice money only. It shows whether the real order path (limit at the level, stop, 2R target, 15:55 close) gets the fills the paper bot assumes. Those Sim fills are what the next step (one small eval test) waits for.
